content: Go race detector: only detects races on interleavings actually executed (clean -race run is not proof); does not track sync/atomic ops in happens-before the way it tracks mutexes/channels - mixing atomics with plain accesses can hide races; ~8192 goroutine limit; not supported on all platforms. Map iteration order is deliberately randomized by the spec - tests asserting on output of range-over-map are flaky; fix by sorting keys (slices.Sort) before compare or use maps.Equal/reflect.DeepEqual instead of serialized output.
